scope: Fixed-base rigid holonomic closed chains; known forces; no impacts, backlash or deformable links in v0.1

input_tracks.video_primary: Observed video prefix plus the same registered action/text/geometry information budget
input_tracks.state_diagnostic: Exact observed state/velocity; separate component diagnostic, never a video model score

sampling.additional_samples: A separate fixed-K setting; retain and average all registered samples

measurement.video_primary: Common frozen calibrated reader over predicted videos; audit on held-out rendered truth
measurement.structured_state: Registered physical-coordinate adapter; latent semantics calibrated using training/validation only
measurement.primary_derivatives: Same registered time grid and differentiator within each comparison
measurement.implemented_differentiator: registered per measurement pipeline: native analytic; calibrated quintic exact-state; calibrated phase fit as projection ablation; spatial manifold-aware differences
measurement.native_derivatives: Optional separate diagnostic; cannot replace common derivatives in a pooled ranking
measurement.resolution_calibration: Independent true-video replay at each native grid; pixel span is not a closure tolerance

dynamics.expression: N(q)^T (M(q) a + c(q,v) + G(q) - B(q) u - Qext - Qfric)

prediction.expression: predicted physical landmarks minus reference landmarks

normalization.source: Registered physical scales from training/calibration or engineering specification only
normalization.zero_reference: Use preregistered positive physical floor; never divide by a zero command
normalization.tangent_basis: Fixed physical independent coordinates; record units and chart atlas
normalization.one_dof_motor_torque: Only when s is the actual crank angle and N1=1; do not relabel arbitrary projected forces Nm

required_controls: Correct physical trajectory through the same reader/sampling/derivative pipeline
Static prediction on an excited trajectory
Geometry-preserving trajectory with wrong time scale or wrong action
Known mass/friction perturbations with documented magnitudes
calibration.freeze_rule: Freeze data split, reader, scales, engineering tolerances and statistical rules before new model test predictions
calibration.failure_of_measurement_floor: Optimize the reader and numerical processing, verify held-out correct and faulty controls, and remeasure all paired predictions; engineering limits unchanged

scoring.primary_output: Scomp continuous tolerance-ratio score plus raw SI errors, coverage and failure reasons
scoring.per_trajectory_pass: All six core metrics measured on the complete declared supports and within calibrated bounds
scoring.missing_core_metric: Unverified, contributes no verified pass; keep cause distinct from demonstrated physical failure
scoring.partial_metric_mean: Conditional on available trajectories, always accompanied by n/expected
scoring.parameter_heads: Not mandatory for a black-box dynamics score; evaluated separately if physically identifiable

diagnostic_modules: Matched positive/negative velocity response for friction; assumptions and coverage explicit
Known SI action response for effective inertia; report nonpositive gains and all outliers
SI mass/friction parameter identification only after actuation-scale anchoring and regressor rank audit
Exact-state component control and fixed-sampling/integrator controls

statistics.paired_comparisons: Same held-out cases, input histories and controls
statistics.confidence_intervals: 95% paired cluster bootstrap; preserve condition pairing, cluster by training seed then trajectory
statistics.one_training_seed: Conditional pilot evidence only; trajectory CI does not measure training uncertainty
